Description: Dameokja stage log metrics, alarms, dashboard and saved queries

AlbFullName.Description: ALB 지표 차원 값 app/<이름>/<ID> (ALB ARN의 loadbalancer/ 뒤)

Properties.AlarmDescription: 전체 요청 5xx가 5분간 기준 건수 이상(ALB 지표: 서버 5xx + ALB 5xx). 정상 타깃이 없을 때(stage 꺼짐)는 ALB 503뿐이라 세지 않음

Metrics.Expression: IF(FILL(hbb, 0) + FILL(hbg, 0) + FILL(hfb, 0) + FILL(hfg, 0) > 0, FILL(target, 0) + FILL(elb, 0), 0)
Metrics.Label: 5xx

Properties.AlarmDescription: backend·frontend 서비스 중 하나라도 메모리 사용률 평균 90% 이상 10분 지속(ECS 지표)

Properties.Name: dameokja-stage/아침 알림 배치 결과
Properties.QueryString:
filter @message like /알림 생성 단계를 마쳤습니다/
| parse @message "refrigeratorCount=*, failedRefrigeratorCount=*, elapsedMillis=*" as total, failed, elapsed
| fields @timestamp, total, failed, elapsed
| sort @timestamp desc

Properties.Name: dameokja-stage/Push 발송 실패 로그
Properties.QueryString:
filter @message like /푸시를 전송하지 못했습니다|Web Push 전송에 실패했습니다|푸시 발송 작업을 처리하지 못했습니다/
| stats count(*) as failures by bin(1h)

Properties.Name: dameokja-stage
Properties.Description: stage ALB 로그 조회. 결과는 로그 버킷 athena/(30일 뒤 삭제)

Properties.Name: SLO 작업별 응답 코드 건수(최근 30일, ALB 로그)
Properties.QueryString:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN request_verb = 'POST' AND regexp_like(path, '^/api/v1/refrigerators/[^/]+/ingredients$') THEN 'ingredient_create' WHEN request_verb = 'GET' AND regexp_like(path, '^/api/v1/refrigerators/[^/]+/ingredients$') THEN 'ingredient_read' WHEN request_verb = 'GET' AND regexp_like(path, '^/api/v1/ingredients/[^/]+$') THEN 'ingredient_read' WHEN request_verb = 'GET' AND regexp_like(path, '^/api/v1/refrigerators/[^/]+/notifications(/stream|/unread-count)?$') THEN 'notification_poll' WHEN request_verb = 'POST' AND regexp_like(path, '^/api/v1/ingredients/[^/]+$') THEN 'aux_consume' WHEN request_verb = 'POST' AND path = '/api/v1/push-subscriptions' THEN 'aux_push_subscribe' ELSE '-' END AS route
  FROM (SELECT *, url_extract_path(request_url) AS path FROM alb_logs
        WHERE day >= date_format(current_date - interval '30' day, '%Y/%m/%d'))
)
SELECT route, elb_status_code / 100 AS class, count(*) AS requests
FROM r WHERE route <> '-'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

Properties.Name: 4xx 코드별 건수(최근 30일, ALB 로그)
Properties.QueryString:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN request_verb = 'POST' AND regexp_like(path, '^/api/v1/refrigerators/[^/]+/ingredients$') THEN 'ingredient_create' WHEN request_verb = 'GET' AND regexp_like(path, '^/api/v1/refrigerators/[^/]+/ingredients$') THEN 'ingredient_read' WHEN request_verb = 'GET' AND regexp_like(path, '^/api/v1/ingredients/[^/]+$') THEN 'ingredient_read' WHEN request_verb = 'GET' AND regexp_like(path, '^/api/v1/refrigerators/[^/]+/notifications(/stream|/unread-count)?$') THEN 'notification_poll' WHEN request_verb = 'POST' AND regexp_like(path, '^/api/v1/ingredients/[^/]+$') THEN 'aux_consume' WHEN request_verb = 'POST' AND path = '/api/v1/push-subscriptions' THEN 'aux_push_subscribe' ELSE '-' END AS route
  FROM (SELECT *, url_extract_path(request_url) AS path FROM alb_logs
        WHERE day >= date_format(current_date - interval '30' day, '%Y/%m/%d'))
)
SELECT elb_status_code AS status, route, count(*) AS requests
FROM r WHERE elb_status_code BETWEEN 400 AND 499
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

Properties.Name: API 서버 처리시간 p95·p99(최근 30일, ALB target_processing_time)
Properties.QueryString:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN request_verb = 'POST' AND regexp_like(path, '^/api/v1/refrigerators/[^/]+/ingredients$') THEN 'ingredient_create' WHEN request_verb = 'GET' AND regexp_like(path, '^/api/v1/refrigerators/[^/]+/ingredients$') THEN 'ingredient_read' WHEN request_verb = 'GET' AND regexp_like(path, '^/api/v1/ingredients/[^/]+$') THEN 'ingredient_read' WHEN request_verb = 'GET' AND regexp_like(path, '^/api/v1/refrigerators/[^/]+/notifications(/stream|/unread-count)?$') THEN 'notification_poll' WHEN request_verb = 'POST' AND regexp_like(path, '^/api/v1/ingredients/[^/]+$') THEN 'aux_consume' WHEN request_verb = 'POST' AND path = '/api/v1/push-subscriptions' THEN 'aux_push_subscribe' ELSE '-' END AS route
  FROM (SELECT *, url_extract_path(request_url) AS path FROM alb_logs
        WHERE day >= date_format(current_date - interval '30' day, '%Y/%m/%d'))
)
SELECT route, count(*) AS requests,
  approx_percentile(target_processing_time, 0.95) AS p95_sec,
  approx_percentile(target_processing_time, 0.99) AS p99_sec
FROM r WHERE route <> '-' AND target_processing_time >= 0 AND (elb_status_code < 400 OR elb_status_code >= 500)
GROUP BY 1
